text.jp:
……そうだ。
そこのクリスタルにはもう触った？
まだなら早く触ってみてね。
text.official_en: Say, do you see that crystal over there? If you’ve yet to lay a hand on it, I encourage you to do so.
text.real_en: ...Oh, right. Have you touched that crystal over there yet? If not, hurry and try it.

text.jp:
……ん？　なんだね。
我々は高尚な魔道の研究をしているんだ。
text.official_en: Yes? May I help you? As you can see, we’re currently engaged in the study of rather complex and sophisticated magical arts.
text.real_en: ...Hm? What is it? We're conducting research into the higher arts of magic.

text.jp:
あのお墓で眠ってる人は
きっとこの国が大好きだったんだね。
text.official_en: Whoever’s resting in that grave must’ve really loved Mysidia.

text.jp:
いらっしゃい。
ミシディア製の道具を見てってちょうだい。
text.official_en: Welcome. Come and take a look at my wares, all made right here in Mysidia.

text.jp:
いわば「考える水」といったところか。
ただし、機嫌を損ねると帰ってこなくなるから
注意してくれたまえよ。
text.official_en: Simply put, it’s capable of thinking for itself. But be careful—it may quite literally run off if it becomes upset.
text.real_en: You could call it 'thinking water.' Just be careful: if you upset it, it might never come back.

text.jp:
うむ……
よし、次はブリザラを教えてやるぞ。
text.official_en: Hmm... I suppose you’re ready for your Blizzara lesson.
text.real_en: Hmm... All right, I'll teach you Blizzara next.

text.jp: え？　そうだっけ？
text.official_en: Wait, really? Hmm...

text.jp:
おい、そこの人間。
ここだ、ここだよ。
text.official_en: Psst, human. Down here.

text.jp:
おじさんに教えてもらった火の魔法を
使えるようになったんだよ！
text.official_en: Look! I was able to cast that fire magic you taught me the other day!
text.real_en: I can cast the fire spell you taught me now!

text.jp:
おっかないだろ？
まぁ、力をもつ魔道書は生きてるような
もんだって先生が言ってたよ。
text.official_en: Scary, huh? My teacher said that powerful grimoires are practically living beings.

text.jp:
この先は魔道図書館。
世界の英知が集う場所……。
text.official_en: Beyond this point lies the Arcane Library, where knowledge and wisdom from across the world are stored.

text.jp:
この滝は魔法の力で
ミシディア中を循環していてね。
水自体が思考して水路を決めるんだよ。
text.official_en: The waterfall here circulates throughout the city with magic. The water itself has a will of its own and decides the path it wishes to take.

text.jp:
この魔道書の138ページに書いてある……
重力魔法は、時空魔法と密接に関係していて……
となると……。
text.official_en: According to page 138 of this grimoire, gravity magic is intricately linked with time magic. Therefore...
text.real_en: It says here on page 138 of this grimoire... Gravity magic is closely related to space-time magic... Which means...

text.jp:
これが、なんでも吸い込んじゃう魔物でね。
なんと仲間の白魔道士が食べられちゃったの。
text.official_en: It has a nasty habit of swallowing everything—in my case, a fellow white mage.
text.real_en: It swallows just about anything. It even ate a fellow white mage!

text.jp:
そこの道具屋、外の街と比べても
そん色ない品ぞろえだろう？
text.official_en: Are you aware that item shop over there has a selection comparable to what is available outside the city?
text.real_en: The item shop over there has a selection just as good as shops outside the city, doesn't it?

text.jp: その若さでファイラを……！？
text.official_en: You mastered Fira...at your age!?

text.jp:
だってそうだろ？
ミシディアが一番見渡せる場所にあるんだもん。
text.official_en: I mean, why else would they have the best view of the city?

text.jp:
ちがうよ、さいしょのまほうつかいは
ふたりいたんだよ！
text.official_en: No it wasn’t! It was made by <text style="italic">TWO</> really amazing mages!
text.real_en: No, there were two mages at the beginning!

text.jp:
なんて言っても、信じてもらえないかもね。
ま、普段使っているものがどこから来たかって
意外と考えなくても暮らせるものよね。
text.official_en: I realize it may be difficult to believe, especially in a world where one can live their life without ever knowing where everyday items come from.
text.real_en: You might not believe me even if I told you. Still, it's surprising how little we need to think about where our everyday things come from.

text.jp:
ふふふ……猫が喋った！
と、驚いているようだね。
text.official_en: Heh heh heh...bet you didn’t expect a talking cat.
text.real_en: Heh heh... You look surprised that a cat just spoke to you.

text.jp:
もしかしたら、この国を出た魔道士で
同じように猫の姿に化けている奴もいるかもな。
text.official_en: So much so, in fact, that I bet there are mages who’ve left this country and spend their days disguised as cats...
text.real_en: There might even be mages who've left this country and taken the form of cats, just like me.

text.jp:
ポ、ポ、ポーション♪　ポポ、ポーション♪
ぐつぐつ煮こむと、あら不思議～♪
プリンにボムにアーリマン～♪
text.official_en:
<text style="italic">Tor-sion mo-tion, mix them up and see—</>
<text style="italic">Po-tion, po-tion, a wonderful sight, a glee—</>
<text style="italic">Down-a-portion, and victorious you’ll be!</>
text.real_en:
<text style="italic">Po, po, potion♪ Po-po, potion♪</>
<text style="italic">Let it simmer away, and what a surprise!♪</>
<text style="italic">Flans and Bombs and Ahrimans!♪</>

text.jp:
ポ、ポ、ポーション♪　ポポ、ポーション♪
ぐるっと混ぜると、あら不思議～♪
ビクトリアスな魔法薬～♪
text.official_en:
<text style="italic">Po-tion, po-tion, boil these till dawn—</>
<text style="italic">Flans, Bombs, and Ahrimans—</>
<text style="italic">They’ll-a-save you from harm—</>
text.real_en:
<text style="italic">Po, po, potion♪ Po-po, potion♪</>
<text style="italic">Mix it all around, and what a surprise!♪</>
<text style="italic">A victorious magic potion!♪</>

text.jp:
ポーションのレシピは
ミシディアでも一部の人しか
知らないのよ。
text.official_en: Only a handful of people in Mysidia know the exact recipe for making potions.

text.jp:
ミシディアっていだいなる
ひとりのまほうつかいが
つくったんだよね！
text.official_en: Mysidia was built by a great mage, right?

text.jp:
ミシディアって空に浮かんでるみたいで
気持ちいいでしょう？
でも、この景色って魔法で表現されているだけなのよ。
text.official_en: It feels as though you’re floating among the clouds here, doesn’t it? But the scenery is simply a projection of magic.

text.jp: ミシディアに、外のお客さんなんて珍しいわね。
text.official_en: An outsider? You’re quite a rare sight.
text.real_en: Visitors from outside Mysidia are a rare sight.

text.jp:
ミシディアは結界のおかげで安全なんだけど
昔はエルフなんかが剣を買っていったものさ。
さ、武器を見ていっておくれ。
text.official_en: While the barrier ensures the safety of our city, the days when elves and other such races would purchase our wares are gone. Now go on, take a look at what I have to offer.
text.real_en: Mysidia is safe thanks to its barrier, but elves used to come here to buy swords. Come on, take a look at our weapons!

text.jp:
世界中で売っているポーションは
そこの工場でつくっているのよ。
text.official_en: All the potions in the world are brewed in that factory.

text.jp:
何百年も前には、本当に空を飛んでいた国が
あったって噂もあるけど……
本当かしらね？
text.official_en: Although, I <text style="italic">have</> heard rumors of a nation said to have been aloft in the skies several centuries ago... I wonder if there’s any truth to it.

text.jp:
回復の薬だけど、つくったのは実は黒魔道士なの。
寿命を延ばす薬をつくっていた時に
ぐーぜんできたんだって。
text.official_en: Even though it heals people, I heard it was accidentally discovered by a black mage who was working on a concoction to prolong life.

text.jp:
外の物を欲しがる物好きが
少なからず居たりするのさ。
私には理解できないがね。
text.official_en: But there are always a few folks who favor items from outside. To each their own, I say.
text.real_en: There are quite a few eccentrics who want things from outside the city. I don't understand them myself.

text.jp:
安心しろ。
私は魔法で猫の姿に化けてるだけだ。
この姿はなかなか過ごしやすくてね……。
text.official_en: Don’t be alarmed. I’m just using magic to change myself into a cat... You’d be surprised how easy life feels in this form.

text.jp:
東の雪原に出た厄介な魔物を
倒しにいったんだけどさ……
text.official_en: I set out to hunt the monster wreaking havoc in the snowfield to the east.
text.real_en: I went to take down a troublesome monster that had appeared in the eastern snowfields, but...

text.jp:
正直、この街に居れば
必要ないものばかりではあるのだが……。
text.official_en: Truth be told, most of the items serve little use in Mysidia...

text.jp:
魔法の心得のない者には
その深淵を覗くことは難しいだろうがね。
text.official_en: Although, one unversed in magic may not be able to comprehend even a fraction of the insight it has to offer.

text.jp:
魔道図書館にはさ
魔物が取り憑いた本もあるんだぜ！
text.official_en: The Arcane Library has books haunted by monsters!

text.jp:
魔道士向けのローブはもちろん
古式ゆかしい鎧なんかもあるよ。
外のお客さんは珍しい。買っていってくれたまえ。
text.official_en: Oh? We don’t get many customers from outside. Well, we’ve a selection of robes for mages as well as pieces of traditional armor. See for yourself.
text.real_en: We've got robes for mages, of course, along with traditional armor. We don't see many visitors from outside. Why not buy something?

text.jp:
黒魔道士が魔法でひるませたら
なんとか吐き出したけど……
今思い出しても恐ろしいわ……。
text.official_en: It spat her out when our black mage hit it with magic, but... I still shudder at the thought.
text.real_en: A black mage stunned it with magic, and it finally spat her out... Even now, just remembering it is terrifying...
